Observations

Same archetype = same silhouette. Each row of 3 pets shares identical body shape. Seed-driven variation is limited to: minor accent color shifts (palette[8], [9] offset by ANSI ±6), variant pixel positions (2 options), '?' pixel fills (50% chance), and motif overlays (10% body pixel swap).

Cross-archetype diversity is good — 8 distinct silhouettes. But within each archetype, the visual difference is minimal. A user who consistently gets "builder" will see nearly identical pets every time.

This is the problem that LLM sprite generation solves: by passing personality traits as natural language to Claude Haiku, every pet gets a unique silhouette while still fitting the archetype theme.
